_comment: PLACEHOLDER VALUES. Every number in this file is invented so the UI can be built before training finishes. Replace `runs` with the real MLflow results (one object per run) and set isMock to false. While isMock is true the app shows a 'Demo data' badge everywhere these numbers appear.
protocol: Same train/val split and seed for every run. One change per run against the baseline (assignment Option A). Latency is model time per image on the laptop CPU at the run's image size.
championRule: Highest mAP50-95 among runs with CPU latency at or under 60 ms.

runs.name: baseline
runs.changed: yolo26n, 640 px, 50 epochs, COCO-pretrained, default augmentation

runs.name: aug-colour-flip
runs.changed: Stronger colour jitter (HSV) and vertical flips

dataset.name: Annotated Potholes Image Dataset (version potholes_yolo_v1)
dataset.licence: ODbL (database) and DbCL (contents), as shown on Kaggle, read 11 Nov 2026
dataset.split: Random by image, seed 42, after a duplicate check
dataset.notes: Images are not in git. The Kaggle download matches the split manifest image for image (SHA-256, data/README.md).
